FROMLIST: misc: throttler: Add core support for non-thermal throttling The purpose of the throttler is to provide support for non-thermal throttling. Throttling is triggered by external event, e.g. the detection of a high battery discharge current, close to the OCP limit of the battery. The throttler is only in charge of the throttling, not the monitoring, which is done by another (possibly platform specific) driver. Signed-off-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> (am from https://patchwork.kernel.org/patch/10505615/) BUG=b:74321682, b:73050145 TEST=build and boot on dru Conflicts: MAINTAINERS drivers/misc/Kconfig drivers/misc/Makefile trivial conflicts caused by upstream adding new drivers and MAINTAINER entries Change-Id: I21336916c3fd4062e8add2f867afc3fcff29f99c Signed-off-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1102142 Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>

sys-apps: usbguard: Add initial usbguard ebuild. Usbguard is a system daemon that allows whitelisting usb devices with a configurable policy. This ebuild includes the init logic needed to prevent new USB devices from being connected when a device is locked while still allowing devices that were connected when Chrome OS was locked. BUG=None TEST=Check that the usbguard-daemon works at the lockscreen. Change-Id: I08fa27b25c3da7692a403998b6414a0cbed534fb Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1114119 Commit-Ready: Allen Webb <allenwebb@google.com> Tested-by: Allen Webb <allenwebb@google.com> Reviewed-by: Jorge Lucangeli Obes <jorgelo@chromium.org>

tcpc: disallow PD_SUSPEND if not enough power We do not want to allow depthcharge to suspend the PD port for a firmware upgrade if there is not enough battery power to last us during the full firmware upgrade. We cannot use the active_charger function as the EC has just jumped to RW and has not fully initialized the charger state. We use Vbus presence as a good enough approximation that power may be coming in from that port. BRANCH=none BUG=b:78334391 TEST=No battery or deeply discharged battery will skip TCPC upgrade on a yorp if there is a usb charger in that port. Otherwise the upgrade will still be attempted. Change-Id: I9af9cb84cfae611b6ab051d318e2083962424de1 Signed-off-by: Jett Rink <jettrink@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1123314 Reviewed-by: Furquan Shaikh <furquan@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: tpm: cr50_spi: reduce readiness delay to 2ms When the TPM ready IRQ is not available, cr50_spi driver falls back to using delay between transactions. While 10ms is a more reliable delay, it significantly slows down firmware updates that need to send large images over the bus. And falling back to delays instead of IRQs may be necessary when starting on devices with old cr50 images that need updating. This CL reduces such fallback delays from 10ms to 2ms. BUG=b:80481396 TEST=boot, cr50 update with ignored IRQs Signed-off-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org> Change-Id: I17302105fce460c6d8ed3c31c03bb12cc8c6286e Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1080128 Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>
